games.title: Mercenary
games.note: A free-roaming 3D vector world: you crash-land on the planet Targ and choose which side to work for.

games.title: Damocles
games.note: Advertised as Mercenary II: a whole solar system to explore before a comet hits the planet Eris.

games.title: Turbo Esprit
games.note: You drive a Lotus Esprit around a city with traffic lights and pedestrians, chasing drug smugglers' cars.

games.title: Hunter
games.note: A 3D island war where you can take almost any vehicle and finish missions however you like.

games.title: Syndicate
games.note: You steer a squad of cyborg agents through isometric cities for a ruthless corporation.

games.title: Space Station Silicon Valley
games.note: A broken robot takes over the bodies of robotic animals to get around a runaway space station.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto 2
games.note: Set in Anywhere City, with gangs whose respect rises or falls depending on whose jobs you take.

games.title: Bully
games.note: Released as Canis Canem Edit in Europe; you attend classes at Bullworth Academy between fights and pranks.

games.title: The Getaway
games.note: Recreated central London street by street and used no on-screen HUD; a car's indicators showed the way.

games.title: L.A. Noire
games.note: Filmed actors' faces with 32 cameras so players could read suspects' expressions during interrogations.

games.title: Gun.Smoke
games.note: A vertically scrolling shooter set in the Old West, designed by Yoshiki Okamoto.

games.title: Red Dead Revolver
games.note: Started at Angel Studios with Capcom funding; Rockstar bought the studio and finished the game after Capcom dropped it.

games.title: Mafia
games.note: Daniel Vávra's 1930s gangster story, where police could pull you over for speeding or running red lights.

games.title: Mafia II
games.note: A Sicilian-American war veteran rises through the mob in Empire Bay, a city modeled on 1940s and 1950s New York.

games.title: Mafia III
games.note: Set in New Bordeaux, a 1968 stand-in for New Orleans, with a soundtrack of licensed 1960s music.

games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
games.note: A realistic medieval RPG set in 1403 Bohemia, partly funded through Kickstarter in 2014.

games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.note: Continues Henry's story in 15th-century Bohemia, adding the city of Kuttenberg.

games.title: Driver
games.note: Martin Edmondson's homage to 1970s car-chase films; its parking-garage driving test was notoriously hard.

games.title: Driver: San Francisco
games.note: Its hero lies in a coma and can 'shift' into any driver on the road.

games.title: Watch Dogs
games.note: A hacker who controls Chicago's traffic lights, cameras and bridges from his phone; its story drew on the Stuxnet worm.

games.title: Watch Dogs 2
games.note: Moved the series to a sunnier San Francisco Bay Area and the hacker group DedSec.

games.title: Saints Row
games.note: Gave players a character creator and online multiplayer in a GTA-style city called Stilwater.

games.title: Saints Row 2
games.note: Added two-player online co-op through the whole story and leaned into absurd side activities.

games.title: Saints Row: The Third
games.note: Turned the series toward slapstick comedy in a new city, Steelport.

games.title: Saints Row IV
games.note: The gang leader becomes US president, then fights an alien invasion with superpowers in a simulation.

games.title: True Crime: Streets of LA
games.note: You play a cop instead of a criminal, in a mapped recreation of about 240 square miles of Los Angeles.

games.title: Sleeping Dogs
games.note: An undercover cop inside a Hong Kong triad; Activision cancelled it and Square Enix picked it up.

games.title: Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction
games.note: You hunt a deck of 52 cards of wanted North Korean leaders, buying airstrikes from rival factions.

games.title: Just Cause
games.note: Avalanche's first game: topple the regime of a fictional island nation with parachutes and car-to-car stunts.

games.title: Just Cause 2
games.note: Its grappling hook and parachute made getting around the main toy; fans later added online multiplayer with a mod.

games.title: Mad Max
games.note: You build up a car called the Magnum Opus while crossing a desert wasteland.

games.title: Crackdown
games.note: From GTA creator David Jones's studio; collecting glowing agility orbs lets your super-cop leap across rooftops.

games.title: Virtua Fighter
games.note: Yu Suzuki's team made one of the first 3D polygon fighting games, on Sega's Model 1 arcade board.

games.title: Shenmue
games.note: Yu Suzuki's project began as a Virtua Fighter RPG; it named and popularized the quick-time event.

games.title: Shenmue III
games.note: Funded by a 2015 Kickstarter that raised over $6 million, eighteen years after Shenmue II.

games.title: Yakuza
games.note: Toshihiro Nagoshi's crime drama set in Kamurocho, a district modeled on Tokyo's Kabukicho.

games.title: Yakuza 0
games.note: A 1988 prequel that became many Western players' way into the series.
